course_intersection — DRIVE course op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.course_intersection(width=7.0, arm=20.0, corner_radius=3.0, arc_pts=16, stop_setback=2.0, crosswalk=4.0) (to call the implementation directly, import drivecourse; drivecourse.course_intersection(width=7.0, arm=20.0, corner_radius=3.0, arc_pts=16, stop_setback=2.0, crosswalk=4.0); from the registry, opsdrive.get("course_intersection"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Four-way intersection on the main course: 2 roads of width w cross at right angles at the origin, each arm has length arm (from the edge of the crossing area), and the 4 concave corners are rounded off with radius corner_radius.

Area = 2(2·arm + w)w − w² + 4r²(1 − π/4). Following left-hand traffic, each arm has 1 crosswalk (crosswalks (4, 2, 2): the centreline of the band crossing the road with width crosswalk (default 4 m) from the end of the corner cut), and each approach (in the order eastbound → northbound → westbound → southbound, approach direction yaw = 0, π/2, π, 3π/2) has 1 stop line (stop_lines (4, 2, 2): segment across the approach lane = the left half in the direction of travel, stop_setback (default 2 m) before the crosswalk) and 1 traffic signal (signal_poses (4, 3): on the far side of the intersection, at the left corner outside the exit-side crosswalk (0.5 m outside on the left), yaw = facing the approaching vehicle = approach direction + π). centerline is the east–west road axis.

Standards and criteria (2026-09-30, user: "match Japanese standards and rules"): width ≥ 7, corner cut ≥ 3 (Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department examination criteria) → params["regulation"]. Intersections with traffic signals are provided with crosswalks and stop lines (Criteria for Conducting Driving Licence Skill Tests, Reiwa 4 (2022), National Police Agency Notice Hei-Unpatsu No. 12, Attachment, Setting of In-Course Layout (4)); the standard stop line is 2 m before the crosswalk (commentary on the traffic-signal installation guidelines), and vehicle signal heads are placed on the far side (exit side) of the intersection (same source); crosswalk width is generally 4 m or more (road marking 201).

Raises ValueError: width or arm not positive, r < 0, crosswalk < 0, arm < r + crosswalk + stop_setback, invalid arc_pts.
